newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-BRANN BERGEN V LIVERPOOL TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRANN BERGEN V LIVERPOOL TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Thursdays European Cup Winners Cup quarter-final first leg match between Brann Bergen of Norway and Liverpool of England on Thursday.

Brann Bergen: 24-Vidar Bahus, 26-Stefan Paldan, 16-Per-Ove Ludvigsen, 3-Claus Eftevaag; 18-Morten Pedersen 6-Eirik Skjalaaen, 5-Roger Helland, 27-Arne Vidar Moen; 8-Geir Hasund, 9-Tore Andre Flo, 17-Agust Gylfason

Liverpool: 1-David James, 14-Neil Ruddock, 12-Steve Harkness 2-Dominic Matteo, 20-Stig Inge Bjornebye, 4-Jason McAteer, 16-Jamie Redknapp, 15-Patrick Berger, 10-John Barnes, 7-Steve McManaman, 9-Robbie Fowler.
